name: Drainage pumping station (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Drainage pumping station, 13 x 7.4 m and 5 m high: brick walls on a concrete plinth, a flat roof behind a brick parapet with an aluminium coping, high-level windows, a sectional roller door and a steel personnel door. Inside: a pump room with three large vertical pumps on plinths (volutes, finned motors, wet-well hatches), blue discharge mains with valves and hand wheels running out through the front wall, an overhead runway beam with a chain hoist; a control room with a fixed run of control cabinets behind a partition with a door. Outside on the +z side the three outfall pipes drop into a concrete headwall with flap valves facing the channel, behind a tube rail.
